description: Non-Material Amendment to planning reference 24/3063/HOT to allow for a number of minor changes arising during construction.  Omission of Approved WindowDuring construction, it was identified that forming the approved window opening would require substantial structural works to support the existing chimney. In addition, the client decided to remove the ensuite bathroom previously served by this window.  Roof Works – Like-for-Like Replacement Inspection revealed the existing roof membrane had deteriorated and was allowing water ingress. The roof was replaced with a new weather-tight membrane, with existing tiles reinstated on a like-for-like basis. Insulation beneath the roof was upgraded to meet current Part L requirements. The appearance of the roof remains unchanged, and we propose that the roof on the drawings be relabelled as new roof to match existing.  Brick-Slip Clad Boxing to Conceal External Pipework?A brick-slip clad enclosure, designed in the style of a brick pier, was installed to conceal external pipework.  Front Gate Configuration – Pedestrian Pass Gate A minor amendment is proposed to introduce a pedestrian pass gate within the existing front gate. The gate would remain unchanged in terms of material, height, and overall appearance, with the only difference being the inclusion of a door within the existing gate line.  Replacement Rooflight?During roof replacement works, the existing rooflight timber was found to be rotten. A new rooflight has been installed to match the existing in appearance, size, and location. This amendment does not alter the external appearance or fenestration of the roof.
